en.description:
Speedrist is a full arcade racer that lives on your Apple Watch: eight tracks, fifteen cars and a long career, drawn in real-time 3D and steered with the Digital Crown. It runs on the watch alone, with no iPhone needed, and most races take a minute or two.

STEER WITH THE DIGITAL CROWN
The car accelerates by itself. Turn the Digital Crown to choose your line across the road, and the car follows the bends. Flick the Digital Crown to throw it into a slide. Tap the screen for nitro, and hold a finger down to brake. Brake assist (Sport, Full or Off) helps you find the pace. Want to steer every degree yourself? Wheel steering, with its own assist, is one setting away.

SLIDE, DRAFT, BOOST
Hold a slide to climb three tiers and leave it with a burst of speed. Slides, near misses, slipstreams, air time and clean overtakes fill a three-segment nitro bar, and each tap spends a segment. Pace notes call the next corner before the fog gives it away.

EIGHT TRACKS, SIXTEEN LAYOUTS
• Capo Ocra: a cape road high above the sea, past a harbour village and olive terraces
• Timber Ridge Pass: spruce, granite switchbacks and a lake under mist that never quite lifts
• Red Dust Run: long straights across a red desert basin at sunset
• Backlot 9: painted flats and stage doors on a film lot after the crews go home
• Highfold Saddle: a snowy mountain pass with plough ridges and an icefall
• Palm Lagoon: a causeway over turquoise water at a pink sunset
• Tidewood Strand: driftwood beaches under a mossy rainforest canopy
• Gauge Downs: test straights, a skid pan and handling loops on a vehicle test ground

Every track runs forward and in reverse, and every layout also comes in Mirror and Night versions. Each track hides a shortcut: find it, take it cleanly and gain a second or two.

FIFTEEN ORIGINAL CARS
Four cars in each of classes C, B and A, from a nimble coupe and a gravel-bred rally car to a wind-tunnel hypercar, plus three Special cars to earn: a one-off sports racer, a gas-turbine car and a desert raider. Each car has its own figures, its own engine voice and four liveries, three of them won on track. Spin them on the Showroom turntable and read their spec sheets and stories. No real brands, no real models.

RACE THE PACK
Up to five rivals share the road, each with a style of their own: smooth, aggressive or always sideways. Bump, rub and squeeze past; walls bounce you back into the race, and nothing breaks.

A CAREER TO CLIMB
Rise from class C to the Special class through three-race Cups, eight-race Tournaments and five-round Knockouts, where the last car in each round is out and the final is one on one against the class champion. Win a Tournament to open its Expert events. That makes 128 career races and 120 stars, and cars, layouts, liveries and the Mirror and Night versions open as you race. Every locked item shows what opens it.

MORE WAYS TO RACE
• Single Race: choose the track, the car, the laps, the rivals and their level
• Time Trial: one lap against gold, silver and bronze times on all 16 layouts, in classes C, B and A
• Practice: unlimited laps to learn a track
• Daily Challenge: a new one-lap challenge every day, with a set car and a twist such as Fog Bank, Night, Mirror or Drift Bonus

Records keep your best laps, best races and career stats, and 24 achievements wait to be earned.

ORIGINAL SOUND
An original synthesized score gives every track its own theme, rising and falling with the race. Every car has its own engine voice, synthesized on the watch, and haptics put the big moments on your wrist.

MADE FOR THE WRIST
• Lower your wrist and the race pauses
• Plays fully offline, with no iPhone nearby
• Large HUD, Reduce Motion, and km/h or mph
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no account and no data collected

Requires Apple Watch Series 9 or later, Apple Watch Ultra 2 or later, or Apple Watch SE 3.
